slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

sunrise walks

once a week, wake up early enough to watch the sunrise alone. starting your day before the world does gives you a quiet head start nobody can take.

small no's

say no to one small thing a day without explaining why. "no, thanks" is a full sentence, and the people who matter won't need the footnote.

beginner hobby

start something you're bad at: drawing, dancing, a new language. being a beginner in front of people kills the fear of looking stupid faster than anything.

conversation fuel

every day, learn one strange fact about history, art or science and tell it to someone. being the person with the interesting story is a confidence you can actually build.

unfiltered photos

take one photo of yourself a week, no filter, no angle. you stop seeing a list of flaws and start seeing a person you'd actually like to know.
